Hi Sasha,

Hope you had a good weekend. Quick note following up on our call last week — I see QuellTech's sandbox credits lapsed on Aug 28 and I want to propose a short, one-time reauthorization so your team can finish the integration POC without restarting.

What I'm proposing: a 7‑day sandbox reauthorization with up to $1,000 in usage credits scoped to the current project (Deal QT-4891). No long-term commitment; this is strictly to unblock engineering validation.

If that works, I can start the approval flow and loop in Kimberly for procurement/contract paperwork. Important to confirm: will the reauthorization need SOC2 evidence before we turn access back on? I attached the standard SOC2 checklist we typically share.

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm procurement contact and any PO timeline
- We confirm the exact accounts/orgs to be reactivated
- I trigger the internal approval once you confirm

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Cheers,
Markus Klein

m: (415) 555-0142

Thanks Markus — appreciate the quick follow-up.

Good to hear from you. A 7-day reauthorization with $1k cap sounds reasonable to our engineering lead. A few items from procurement before we can accept:
- We need a one-page MOA (memorandum of agreement) that states the one-time nature of the credit and data handling assurances
- A copy of the SOC2 evidence (or a pointer to where you host the attestation)
- A billing contact for any overages (we prefer to avoid surprises)

I have CC'd contracts@quelltech.com (Procurement) — they will confirm PO timing. If you can share the MOA and SOC2 artifact, procurement can fast-track a small PO within 2 business days.

Sasha Miller
Head of Platform, QuellTech

Jordan — please watch for the Finance ticket after I submit.
